sloka: गच्छेयम् स्व शरीरेण देवानाम् परमाम् गतिम् ।वसिष्ठम् स समाहूय कथयामास चिन्तितम् ॥१-५७-१२॥
transliteration: gaccheyam sva śarīreṇa devānām paramām gatim ।vasiṣṭham sa samāhūya kathayāmāsa cintitam ॥1-57-12॥

translations.english: O Descendant of Kakustha wandering alone burning with distress night and day the king went to Viswamitra who was rich in asceticism.
